scope.purpose: GitHub-deliverable evidence for BACKTEST_AND_VALIDATION.md without publishing pre-existing untracked archives.

numeric_conventions.returns_weights_completion_and_drawdown: decimal ratios, not percentages; drawdown is signed nonpositive
numeric_conventions.aum_yuan: predeclared research parameters, not account balances or approved live allocations

scope.archive_provenance: source_path and SHA256 identify development-side archival files; these paths are not hyperlinks or promised GitHub downloads. Extracted summaries below travel with this JSON.
scope.method: Read saved JSON fields and source documents locally; no production query, raw-data download or historical return recalculation.

v713_paper_20260928.ledger_type: V7.13 Base paper ledger; not live_v713_base and not Shadow_Base
v713_paper_20260928.benchmark: CSI 1000 price index, not a pure microcap TOP50 backtest
v713_paper_20260928.cash_flow_convention: External flows are assigned to interval end, per archived analysis code.
limitations: Short observed paper-ledger window, not annualized here.
Old marks, income recognition and execution/accounting differences can affect results.
Overall portfolio beta includes ETF and cash allocation; it is not stock-sleeve alpha.

experiments.A: Smallest total-market-cap 50 stocks after common investability filters; no ROE filter
experiments.B: Same investability rules plus V713 PIT ROE-positive and year-over-year improvement rules; smallest 50
experiments.C: Fixed 50% B stock sleeve plus 50% exact V713 Hydra sleeve, monthly rebalance
experiments.D: V713 B sleeve with exact T1/Aux rules and exact V713 Hydra sleeve

v713_attribution_protocol.fixed_blend_choice: predeclared simple control, no optimization on evaluation returns
v713_attribution_protocol.selection_aum_status: existing research default; verify production manifest before freezing execution scenarios
data_gates: Verify deployed source and target manifests; bind source SHA256 and data provenance
Point-in-time listing, delisting, ST, suspension, shares and financial announcement availability
Use total capital consistently; do not silently substitute float shares for delisted stocks
Stock adjusted returns and raw prices must have a documented common corporate-action basis
Exact V713 Hydra history; live V481-RB is not an interchangeable proxy
No missing-price reweighting, missing-return zero fills or hindsight delisting exclusions
Month-end signals executed no earlier than the next tradable session; no same-close fills
Same complete-portfolio fees, liquidity, participation, price-limit, lot and cash constraints
Report unavailable and unrecoverable inputs explicitly; no fabricated returns

inference.alpha_convention: regression intercept, not proof of causal or investable alpha
inference.annualization: compound growth uses elapsed calendar time; regression intercept stays per interval
inference.chronological_evaluation: freeze split only after data coverage inventory, before inspecting performance; label retrospective holdout honestly

policy_definitions.fixed50_3d: Fixed initial reference-close buy limit +0.5%, maximum three sessions.
policy_definitions.gold100_us150_3d: Fixed initial reference-close limit: gold +1%, Nasdaq/S&P ETFs +1.5%, maximum three sessions; other six ETFs and sells retain prior boundaries.
policy_definitions.gold100_us150_2d: Change only the three focus ETFs buy horizon to two sessions; keep other orders at three.

daily.source_selector: primary portfolios and focus3 BUY metrics; bootstrap.gold100_us150_3d

limitations: Historical model results, not broker executions.
Parameters were selected retrospectively; confidence intervals are not a prospective validation.
ETF fee/lot assumptions, coarse-bar liquidity and incomplete historical premium gates do not certify V713 stock execution.
Two- and three-session focus-buy completion is equal in this 60-minute sample; no proven superiority of day three.
